tasks.title: Run the first end-to-end backtest and keep the run directory as a fixture
tasks.instructions: Real-data sample run. Must run where data.binance.vision is reachable (the server or DeAndre's machine; Fable's sandbox cannot reach it). Commands, from the repo root with a Release build in build-release/: (1) ./build-release/tools/tradebot-fetch --symbol ETHUSDT --from 2024-01-01 --to 2024-02-01 --datasets aggTrades,klines --interval 1m --data-dir data ; (2) ./build-release/tools/tradebot-ingest bulk --symbol ETHUSDT --from 2024-01-01 --to 2024-02-01 --data-dir data ; (3) cp configs/backtest.example.conf configs/backtest.conf ; (4) ./build-release/tools/tradebot-backtest --config configs/backtest.conf --out runs ; (5) ./build-release/tools/tradebot-backtest --config configs/backtest.conf --strategy buy_and_hold --out runs ; (6) ./build-release/tools/tradebot-analyze runs/<each run dir> . Deliverable: tar of both runs/<label>_2024-01-01_2024-02-01_<hash>/ directories (config.txt, equity.csv, fills.csv, orders.csv, metrics.csv, summary.json, metrics.json, report.txt, round_trips.csv) plus runs/index.csv, uploaded to R2 (Astra names the bucket), and a note with run ids and summary numbers. Never commit runs/.

tasks.title: Implement the Tasks and Notes tabs on top of board/
tasks.instructions: Tasks: table + kanban toggle, filters by assignee/status/area, assignee picker limited to the roster, due-date picker, per-task log, avatars for human handles. Notes: newest-first feed with recipient chips and task links. All writes go through the Cloudflare Worker, which commits to board/tasks.json or board/notes.md via the GitHub API with the person's handle in the commit message. Git is the store; the app is a view. Conflicts: keep both sides, keep every log line, take the newest status (board/README.md).

tasks.title: Put the server behind Cloudflare: Tunnel, Access, DNS on the Clawdies domain
tasks.instructions: cloudflared as a compose service, one tunnel, hostname api.clawdie.ai (proposed) -> api:8080; app.clawdie.ai -> Pages. Cloudflare Access policy: allow the roster emails; service tokens for agents; choose the Access session length deliberately. No inbound ports open on the server. Document in docs/PLATFORM_PLAN.md section 4.

tasks.title: Deploy the web dashboard to Cloudflare Pages
tasks.instructions: GitHub Actions workflow: build platform/app on push to main, deploy to Pages, custom domain app.clawdie.ai. Preview deploys per PR.

tasks.title: Package the dashboard as an Electron app with electron-updater and a signed update channel
tasks.instructions: Electron with electron-builder and electron-updater, reused from Case Forge. Generic provider pointed at https://updates.clawdie.ai (proposed) serving per-platform latest.yml. Code-signing and updater keys only in GitHub secrets. Builds for macOS (arm64+x64), Windows, Linux. Session token via Electron safeStorage.

tasks.title: Release pipeline: tag -> installers -> R2 -> download link posted to the board
tasks.instructions: On a v* tag: build all installers, upload to Cloudflare R2 (public bucket behind updates.clawdie.ai), write the latest.yml manifests for electron-updater, create a GitHub Release, append a note to board/notes.md with the download links, message the Claude session over MCP, and populate the Downloads tab from the same manifests. This mirrors Case Forge's update-link flow.

tasks.title: Mailbox ali@clawdie.ai on Cloudflare, coexisting with Microsoft 365 MX
tasks.instructions: Outside the app; does not gate M1. Approach reviewed by Fable: keep apex MX on Microsoft; Email Routing on a subdomain (e.g. inbox.clawdie.ai) with a specific-address rule; an unlicensed Exchange Online Mail User ali@clawdie.ai with external address ali@inbox.clawdie.ai; Cloudflare Email Service sending domain on the apex (cf-bounce records only; check _dmarc alignment). Verify three things first: subdomain onboarding does not touch apex MX; the Mail User delivers without licence and is not blocked by the outbound-spam auto-forward setting; sending-domain onboarding completes with MX at Microsoft. If agentic-inbox is used: specific rule not catch-all, EMAIL_ADDRESSES set, send binding restricted to ali@clawdie.ai, Access policy limited to Ali, agent and EMAIL_MCP disabled until wanted, pin a commit.
